retain_custom_instructions: Every extracted fact MUST be understandable standalone, with zero surrounding context. Rules: (1) Resolve pronouns and indirect references ('it', 'both', 'this', 'that task', 'the app', 'the chart') to the specific named person, company, project, document, or tool they denote. If the conversation never names the referent, DO NOT extract that fact at all — a fact with an unresolvable reference is worse than no fact. (2) Write out abbreviations in full the first time they appear in a fact (e.g. 'General Ledger (GL)', never bare 'GL'). (3) 'The user' and 'the assistant' are acceptable referents — do NOT append bank names, run names, or identifiers to them. (4) Extract durable knowledge only: facts about the business, its customers, projects, decisions, people, tools, data, and preferences. Skip conversational mechanics (that something was asked, retried, acknowledged, or apologized for), assistant self-description, and test/probe/verification exchanges. (5) Prefer fewer, richer facts: merge closely related statements about the same entity into one complete sentence rather than several fragments, and never extract two facts that restate the same information.
